proposedPromotionTypes.name: Featured placement
proposedPromotionTypes.purpose: Request actual discovery placement inventory with confirmed cost, timing and review; no ranking or result guarantee.

proposedPromotionTypes.name: Automatic offer
proposedPromotionTypes.purpose: An approved percentage/fixed benefit on actual eligible priced components; use the existing rule/price owner, not a second price editor.

proposedPromotionTypes.name: Code-based offer
proposedPromotionTypes.purpose: An approved benefit with explicit code, redemption scope and limits, validated by its authoritative owner.

proposedPromotionTypes.name: Bundle or plan offer
proposedPromotionTypes.purpose: A benefit on a real published bundle/plan, with contents, first-term versus renewal scope and redemption/booking terms.

proposedPromotionTypes.name: Enquiry campaign
proposedPromotionTypes.purpose: Promote an actual quoted/provider/coordination service with its real request CTA; never invent a final checkout price.

flow.title: Choose objective and promotion type
flow.outcome: Only capability/policy-supported types can continue; retain draft context.

flow.title: Choose actual offerings and locations
flow.outcome: Show eligible, excluded and unresolved candidates with reasons and links to their owner.

flow.title: Configure the approved benefit or placement
flow.outcome: Reference actual priced components, units, limits, stacking and source authority; no base-price duplication.

flow.title: Set timing and customer conditions
flow.outcome: Separate transaction window from actual service/pickup/departure/redemption dates and show material terms.

flow.title: Review funding, inventory and cost
flow.outcome: Known authorized fee/benefit owner and enforceable caps; unsupported or unknown terms remain unresolved.

flow.title: Preview the actual customer journey
flow.outcome: Correct media/specification/price/terms/CTA for the selected offering, variant and date context.

flow.title: Save, validate and submit
flow.outcome: Versioned owner command with required review; pending remains pending and timeout remains unknown.

flow.title: Schedule, activate and manage
flow.outcome: Owner-confirmed states, permitted edit/pause/resume/end actions and explicit eligibility loss behavior.

flow.title: Validate at transaction acceptance
flow.outcome: Owner rechecks actual selected item/time/quantity, price, eligibility and limits; accepted terms are snapshotted.

flow.title: Inspect measured results and recover
flow.outcome: Actual confirmed redemptions, funded amounts and source-defined metrics with coverage; reconcile failures without duplicate spend.

ORDER.label: Products, food and retail
ORDER.unit: Actual item/variant, pack, weight or volume
qualifiers: published actual item and compatible variants
optional approved minimum spend/quantity and limits
ORDER.dateMeaning: Purchase/redemption window; fulfilment windows only if the service actually supports them.
ORDER.benefit: Approved priced item/component benefit; optional supported fulfilment benefit stays with its owner.
ORDER.customer: Actual item/variant with relevant specification, original/selected price, saving and nearby terms.
ORDER.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

APPOINTMENT.label: Appointments
APPOINTMENT.unit: Actual service, duration, provider and location
qualifiers: booking window distinct from service dates
APPOINTMENT.dateMeaning: Book-by dates and service dates/times are independent; display both in Africa/Nairobi.
APPOINTMENT.benefit: Approved service-price component; no capacity is created by a campaign.
APPOINTMENT.customer: Service scope/duration, eligible date/time/location, selected price and actual available times.
APPOINTMENT.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

FIELD_VISIT.label: Customer-location visits
FIELD_VISIT.unit: Actual scoped package/workload, team time and service area
qualifiers: known priced package or accepted assessment
FIELD_VISIT.dateMeaning: Booking window and actual visit window/coverage are separate.
FIELD_VISIT.benefit: Only a known approved package/fee component; unknown workload uses a request offer.
FIELD_VISIT.customer: Scope, actual coverage, included supplies, price/estimate and supported request/visit action.
FIELD_VISIT.cta: Check coverage and choose or request a visit
FIELD_VISIT.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

ASSET_INTERVAL.label: Vehicle or asset rentals
ASSET_INTERVAL.unit: Actual asset/class and exact rental charge period
qualifiers: minimum/maximum duration and eligible rate component
pickup dates distinct from booking dates
handover locations and joint driver allocation where needed
ASSET_INTERVAL.dateMeaning: Book-by dates, qualifying pickup dates and rental start/end are separate; exact local-date/instant semantics remain intact.
ASSET_INTERVAL.benefit: Approved rental-rate component; deposits, cover, fuel or extras are treated according to explicit component rules, not blanket defaults.
ASSET_INTERVAL.customer: Vehicle/class specifications, duration qualification, selected interval total, saving, deposit and terms separately.
ASSET_INTERVAL.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

TRANSFER.label: Transfers and greetings
TRANSFER.unit: Actual route/service, party, vehicle or greeter
qualifiers: travel time and actual resource confirmation
TRANSFER.dateMeaning: Book-by window and actual trip/greeting dates are separate.
TRANSFER.benefit: Known approved trip/greeting component; no fake final price for an unquoted route.
TRANSFER.customer: Actual route/scope, seats/luggage or greeting terms, waiting, selected fare and extras.
TRANSFER.cta: Choose the actual trip or greeting
TRANSFER.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

SESSION_CAPACITY.label: Events, classes and sessions
SESSION_CAPACITY.unit: Actual dated occurrence, tier and place quantity
SESSION_CAPACITY.dateMeaning: Purchase window and actual session/admission dates are distinct.
SESSION_CAPACITY.benefit: Approved ticket/place-price component and real quantity limits.
SESSION_CAPACITY.customer: Actual event/class, occurrence, included admission, tier/quantity, selected price and entry terms.
SESSION_CAPACITY.cta: Choose an eligible occurrence and places
SESSION_CAPACITY.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

SPACE_RESERVATION.label: Tables and venue spaces
SPACE_RESERVATION.dateMeaning: Booking window and actual occupancy dates/times are separate.
SPACE_RESERVATION.benefit: Approved known fee/benefit only; a space reservation does not create a food order or unknown event quote.
SPACE_RESERVATION.customer: Space/party limits, actual time, fee/minimum spend and clear conditions.
SPACE_RESERVATION.cta: Choose a compatible space and time
SPACE_RESERVATION.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

TOUR.label: Tours and safari departures
TOUR.unit: Actual departure, party format and supplier-confirmed inclusions
TOUR.dateMeaning: Book-by dates and departure/travel dates are separate.
TOUR.benefit: Approved priced departure/package component; supplier enquiry never becomes instant inventory.
TOUR.customer: Itinerary, duration, party model, inclusions, selected price and supplier/cancellation terms.
TOUR.cta: Choose an eligible departure or request confirmation
TOUR.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

PRODUCTION_DUE.label: Custom production
PRODUCTION_DUE.unit: Accepted product specification and production commitment
qualifiers: actual custom product/options and proof process
PRODUCTION_DUE.dateMeaning: Order-by window, proof/acceptance deadline and production due date are distinct.
PRODUCTION_DUE.benefit: A known approved component may be promoted; an unknown final custom quote cannot be advertised as a guaranteed discount total.
PRODUCTION_DUE.customer: Actual customizable item, allowed options, lead time, approval process and quote/known-fee benefit.
PRODUCTION_DUE.cta: Specify the work and request or obtain acceptance
PRODUCTION_DUE.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

REQUEST_QUOTE.label: Quoted, professional and provider enquiries
REQUEST_QUOTE.unit: Actual enquiry/coordination scope and known fees only
qualifiers: approved content and applicable promotion policy
REQUEST_QUOTE.dateMeaning: Campaign/request period and requested work/travel dates are separate.
REQUEST_QUOTE.benefit: Discoverability/enquiry offer, or a separately approved known fee component. Never invent the final service price.
REQUEST_QUOTE.customer: Actual provider/service scope, known fee if any, terms and accurate enquiry CTA.
REQUEST_QUOTE.cta: Request a quote or contact the authorized provider
REQUEST_QUOTE.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

LINKED_WINDOWS.label: Laundry and collection/return work
LINKED_WINDOWS.unit: Actual items/kg/workload and compatible paired promises
qualifiers: declared processing unit and actual rate
LINKED_WINDOWS.dateMeaning: Campaign order window, collection window and feasible return promise remain distinct.
LINKED_WINDOWS.benefit: Approved unit/package component, revalidated after any accepted assessment adjustment.
LINKED_WINDOWS.customer: Accepted item/care scope, unit rate, offer, collection/return information and assessment terms.
LINKED_WINDOWS.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

SERVICE_JOB.label: Workshop, diagnostics and repair
SERVICE_JOB.unit: Actual diagnostic or accepted job/parts/labour scope
qualifiers: diagnostic fee distinct from final repair
SERVICE_JOB.dateMeaning: Campaign intake window and actual assessed work/turnaround are separate.
SERVICE_JOB.benefit: Known diagnostic or accepted work component only; no made-up final repair discount.
SERVICE_JOB.customer: Compatibility, diagnostic/job scope, known offer, exclusions and actual intake/assessment action.
SERVICE_JOB.cta: Request intake or accept the actual job quote
SERVICE_JOB.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

ENTITLEMENT.label: Memberships, passes and supply plans
ENTITLEMENT.unit: Actual plan benefits, quantity, validity and redemption
ENTITLEMENT.dateMeaning: Enrol-by window, benefit validity and each redemption/service date are distinct.
ENTITLEMENT.benefit: Approved first-term/enrolment or explicitly supported renewal component; no silent perpetual renewal discount.
ENTITLEMENT.customer: Included credits/access/deliveries, validity, selected term price, renewal and separate booking terms.
ENTITLEMENT.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

FREIGHT.label: Sea, air and road freight
FREIGHT.unit: Actual route, kg/m3/container/load and accepted cargo
qualifiers: quote validity and actual accepted charges
FREIGHT.dateMeaning: Quote/campaign validity and actual cargo/shipping dates are separate.
FREIGHT.benefit: Discovery or approved known/accepted tariff component; no universal cart minimum or invented volumetric divisor.
FREIGHT.customer: Route/mode, charge basis, applicable benefit/quote, inclusions and private declaration path.
FREIGHT.cta: Declare the shipment and request a carrier quote
FREIGHT.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

STORAGE.label: Warehouse storage
STORAGE.unit: Actual compatible unit/area/volume/pallet and occupancy period
qualifiers: typed accepted goods and compatible environment
STORAGE.dateMeaning: Enrol/request window, occupancy dates and billing periods remain distinct.
STORAGE.benefit: Discovery or an approved known storage/handling component; actual unit capacity still requires acceptance.
STORAGE.customer: Unit fit, accepted goods, period, price/quote basis, handling and access terms.
STORAGE.cta: Choose the storage scope and request capacity acceptance
STORAGE.monetaryScopeCondition: An actual known approved price component, benefit contract, funding/stacking policy and current authority are required. Never discount an unknown final quote.

campaigns.purpose: One campaign directory for offers and Featured placement campaigns.
campaigns.creation: Create promotion opens one flow; select a supported type before its relevant fields. There is no separate Featured placements tab or directory.
campaigns.details: The selected type supplies its benefit or placement fields within the same detail/editor shell. Preview in app remains available in the selected campaign.

featuredPlacements.purpose: Type-specific fields for a Featured placement campaign inside Campaigns; placement alone does not create a discount.
displayFields: confirmed fee/quote and separate charge state
actions: Submit the selected campaign's placement request through the common creation flow
featuredPlacements.confirmation: A request, review approval, inventory hold, charge and confirmed placement are separate facts; only the actual owner can confirm each.
featuredPlacements.previewMode: Use the selected public revision and channel/location/date context, including any independently eligible linked offer.

history.purpose: Inspect ended/cancelled/rejected campaigns, their actual changes and saved public presentation.
actions: View results or charges where supported
history.previewMode: Archived presentation uses the saved public revision and historical date context. It is not current eligibility or a live offer.
history.reuse: Duplication creates a new draft with new identity and current validation; it never restarts the archived campaign or copies a paid placement booking.

customerAppPreview.purpose: Let a merchant inspect how the selected promotion/placement appears in the customer app before or after publication.
entryPoints: campaign selected detail, including Featured placement type
contextFields: transaction and use dates where relevant
customerAppPreview.rule: Use actual public renderer, selected price/benefit/terms and model CTA. Navigation inside preview switches preview surfaces; it cannot order, book, pay, reserve, redeem or publish.
customerAppPreview.archive: Archived mode uses the saved public representation and clearly states that the offer has ended; never substitute today's price or availability for historical values.
customerAppPreview.failure: Unknown current source or incomplete saved representation produces an explicit unavailable/partial preview, not fabricated content or stale data presented as current.
customerAppPreview.exit: Back returns to the originating tab, selection, filters and draft/revision context.
